description: A converger's report of one round on the pull request: what it checked and found, whether it claims convergence, the change and the head it pushed, and the thread replies, resolutions and reruns it made

snapshot.description: The pull request state snapshot Ref this request gave, copied byte-exact from request.inputs

converged.description: Whether this round claims the pull request has converged. The claim does not cover the items reported as skipped or not_checked

unconverged.description: What remains before the pull request converges, one item each; required exactly when converged is false

items.description: Every check of this round with its status, ids unique. Exactly one item has the id quality-scan

correction.description: Where this round left the worktree HEAD. committed: at a new commit after the previous report's head, pushed to the pull request record's branch. no_change: still at that head, with nothing pushed

head.description: The worktree HEAD at the end of this round, which, when committed, is the commit pushed to the pull request record's branch

thread_actions.description: Every reply to and resolution of a review thread of the pull request that this round made, one entry each; empty when there was none

ci_reruns.description: Every GitHub Actions workflow run that this round reran, one entry each; empty when there was none

id.description: The check's id; quality-scan is the quality scan

status.description: passed or failed when the check ran. skipped: a check whose id this schema lists for it was not run because its precondition is missing, which the reason states. not_checked: the check could not run, or has no result yet, for another reason, which the reason states. Neither skipped nor not_checked is a pass

reason.description: What was checked and found; for skipped, the missing precondition; for not_checked, why it could not run or has no result

thread_id.description: The review thread's GraphQL node ID

action.description: reply: a comment added to the thread. resolve: the thread marked resolved

comment_id.description: The GraphQL node ID of the reply's comment; required for reply and only for it

run_id.description: The ID of the GitHub Actions workflow run, not of one of its check runs or jobs
